text.source: Results: county returns as published by NBC News (from the Associated Press) on Nov 7, 2026, with about 96% of the expected vote counted statewide. Counts are unofficial until certified. Shares are two-party (Cory Booker vs. Justin Murphy); independent Veronica Fernandez and other minor candidates are left out. Swing compares with the 2020 U.S. Senate county results (two-party share, Booker vs. Rikin Mehta). Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 county estimates (Vintage 2025, table co-est2025-pop-34).
